sections.name: The report behind the price, read before the buyer reads it.

items.text: What a quality of earnings report is
The report behind the price, read before the buyer reads it.

A quality of earnings report is an independent analysis of what a business actually earns, as distinct from what it reports: revenue and expenses traced to bank records and tax filings, the non-recurring and personal items identified, and a normalized earnings figure a buyer or lender can underwrite. It is a consulting engagement under the AICPA’s standards, not an audit, a review or a compilation. From October 1, 2026, an SBA lender must obtain one, commissioned for the lender, on any acquisition loan at a purchase price of $3 million or more.
Capital Row reads an owner’s numbers the way that report will, first: the Pre-Market Assessment, then the preparation review, then the Sell-Side QoE from the independent CPA firm we partner with.

Operators, clinicians and transaction advisors, working together on each engagement. Tap or click a card to read the bio.

Shawnee is a behavioral health operator and M&A advisor. She helped scale a private equity-backed healthcare platform from roughly 6,000 to 22,000 employees and built the post-close integration model for Keck Medicine of USC across more than 45 clinics. Her career spans academic medicine, private equity-backed healthcare systems, and health-tech, with transaction experience across behavioral health, home health, hospice, and physician services. She founded Behavioral Blueprints to help behavioral health owners buy, grow, and exit with confidence.
Dennis Nelson directs operations at Capital Row and leads its transportation and logistics desk.

Dr. Benjamin is a psychiatrist and clinical leader with more than two decades in mental health treatment, clinician training, and program development. He served 21 years in the U.S. Air Force, including as Medical and Administrative Director of the Tinker Air Force Base Substance Abuse Program, and has held leadership roles at Ventura County Behavioral Health and the Oklahoma City VA. He specializes in psychiatric collaboration, trauma-informed care, and high-acuity conditions, and has published more than 30 research articles and books.

Dr. Allen brings more than 35 years of experience as a clinician, entrepreneur, and M&A advisor to private and publicly traded healthcare companies, with transaction experience across more than 52 healthcare verticals and cross-border deals. He holds a DDS from Creighton University and an MBA in Investment Banking from the University of Bedfordshire, and is a Certified M&A Professional (CM&AP). He is the author of Value Engineering, Sell Your Healthcare Company at a Premium, and The Legacy Premium.

Mike brings more than three decades of healthcare financial and operational consulting experience. He founded The Tucker Advisory Group in 2007 and has delivered interim management, financial valuation, practice assessments, and revenue cycle improvement for providers, health networks, lenders, and law firms. He supports healthcare lenders with due diligence on new, existing, and distressed credits and provides expert testimony. He holds a BS in Finance from Penn State and an MBA from Drexel University.

Dan is a licensed Marriage and Family Therapist with more than 45 years in behavioral health program development and clinician training. He founded Praxes Behavioral Health, has launched more than 250 behavioral health programs, and has trained more than 5,000 professionals. He led a Long Beach outpatient agency’s growth from 11 to 75 employees and from $2 million to $7 million in revenue, and helps organizations secure funding for program growth.
